title: Assistant Manager Finance
how_to_apply: CV aur last salary slip hr@alnoor.example par bhejein. Email ka subject: AM Finance.
description: Monthly closing, sales tax aur income tax filings, bank reconciliation aur internal audit follow-up. Candidate ko ERP (SAP ya Oracle) par 2 saal ka haath hona chahiye. Reporting line: Finance Manager. Office Gulberg III, Lahore mein hai; Saturday half day.

title: Lab Technician (BPS-09)
employer_display: District Health Authority, Sukkur — Government of Sindh
qualification: F.Sc Pre-Medical + Diploma in Lab Technology
how_to_apply: Prescribed form DHA office Sukkur se lein ya website se download karein. Attested documents, CNIC copy, domicile aur 2 tasveerein sath laayein. Rozana 9 baje se 2 baje tak receive honge.
description: BHU aur TB clinic par routine lab tests — blood, urine, sputum smear. Samples record register mein darj karna, aur weekly report DHIS mein upload karna. Contract 12 mahine ka hai, extension performance par.

title: Graphic Designer (Part Time)
qualification: Bachelor's in Design / Diploma + strong portfolio
how_to_apply: Portfolio ka link aur 3 sample social posts jobs@example.com par bhejein. Subject: Part-time Designer.
description: Social media creatives, poster design aur basic motion graphics for local brands. Haftay mein 20 ghante, timing flexible, Karachi se remote. Figma aur Illustrator lazmi; After Effects bonus.
